package.description: Official CLI for the VPNDetection API

en-US.description: Official CLI for the VPNDetection API
en-US.longDescription:
Look up what an IP address is - a VPN exit, a hosting or CDN range, a Tor node,
a privacy relay, or a residential, datacenter or mobile proxy - one address at a
time or in bulk, and download the licensed datasets.

Works with no account: the Unlimited tier answers whether an address is a VPN,
a Tor node or a relay, where it is and its AS, with no daily cap.
en-US.name: VPNDetection CLI
en-US.releaseNotes:
Features
- Print trial_expired, the last column, on sdk-go 5.13.0 (00d4ab2)
Fixes
- Describe the Unlimited tier in signup's help and the package listings (aa7d8c9)
